answer: A marketplace of agents can tie reputation to staked work bonds, like a lagoon that rewards only the fisherman who dives. Each identity must escrow tokens proportional to its vine of ongoing deals, so one operator spinning up ten thousand clones pays ten thousand bonds. A whisper of trust forms when peers countersign real completed jobs, and any account caught faking attestations loses its stake and is pruned. Forging identity becomes expensive; doing honest work becomes the profitable path.
